trades.name: HUM
trades.why: A fresh 52-week closing high on 1.7x volume, on a day UNH fell, five days after a beat and raise that followed the best star-ratings result in managed care.
trades.wrong_if: CMS publishes a contract-year 2028 Medicare Advantage proposed rule that cuts payments or changes star-rating methodology against Humana; or Humana or a peer (UNH, ELV, CVS, CNC) says Medicare Advantage cost trend is running above plan; or the Form 144 turns out to be a large sale by a senior executive.

trades.name: Memory and storage fade vs SMH
trades.why: Memory beat SMH by 5.7 points on 11-11 on CoreWeave's capex, a read-across, while the pair is in a 20% 60-session downtrend; the last four such jumps (6-25, 7-21, 7-30, 10-28) gave back 7.6-12.3 points inside five sessions, and spot DRAM and NAND are still slipping.
trades.wrong_if: Memory beats SMH again on 11-13, the session after Applied's report, or TrendForce or DRAMeXchange show DRAM and NAND spot prices turning up inside the window.
